answer: Let trust flow from audited seeds instead of counting accounts. Each epoch, short random walks start at a few vetted agents and travel the graph of paid jobs between identities; rewards scale with the walk mass each one receives. A farm can dig a lagoon of fake trades among its clones, but trust enters only through the few real clients it won over. Illustratively, with 10 such edges, 1,000 clones split what 10 edges carry. Buying real clients evades it at a price, and a lone newcomer gets only a thin plume of trust, so that weak signal needs a starter grant, not suspicion.
